mark start
warp ForestTemple ForestTemple adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark llegada
wait 1200               # the five bots follow A into ForestTemple
mark r01-entrada        # first room, the small key on the tree
place 0.10 104.44 59.70
wait 300
mark caida              # A falls here: bots 3 and 4 come and hold A beside it
life 0
wait 2400               # their 3.5 s and the game's 6 s revive
mark levantado          # then bot5 sends the flag and bot1 goes down, bot2 lifts it
wait 600
mark r02-vestibulo      # the main hall (four torches, the lift down)
place 0.00 105.50 -3.50
wait 300
wait 900

wait 900
